programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees: Season 1
programme.desc: National Geographic traveler and explorer, Bertie Gregory, takes viewers on a fascinating journey into the world of bees.For three years, the creators of the documentary conducted observations, using specialized cameras placed inside the hive to capture the life of these insects up close.The film reveals their complex architecture, social behavior and extraordinary intelligence of over 20,000 species of bees.They are responsible for pollinating one third of the food produced in the world and are considered one of the most important animals on our planet. Director and explorer Bertie Gregory has been working with National Geographic for years.Traveling to the farthest corners of the world, he has already explored the secret lives of sharks, penguins and cheetahs.His latest film, produced by James Cameron, is exceptional.It talks about the world of insects that are right next to us.Although scientists are aware of their key role in the ecosystem, they still hide many secrets and can surprise.More and more advanced filming technology allows you to look at inconspicuous bees from a groundbreaking perspective - on a scale where even flowers look like skyscrapers.The world of small giants The creators of the documentary placed specialized cameras inside the hive to closely observe its inhabitants for three years.This allowed them to capture how insects communicate and use tools.They saw what happens when a hive is attacked.The second part of the document shows, among others:fight for survival before the coming winter.In different parts of the Earth, different species face their own challenges - some compete for mates by living in clay hideouts, others try to survive the attack of a parasite.Researchers are looking for ways to ensure the future of small giants.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The Savute region, which is located in Botswana, can be both a benevolent paradise and an extremely brutal hell for animals.However, it will always be unpredictable.Covering an area of ​​three thousand square miles, the African savanna is home to competing clans of predators.The survival of lions, leopards, hyenas and wild deer depends on huge herds of their potential prey - buffaloes, elephants and zebras.Every day means a fight for survival, in which the law of nature is the most important.The series has six episodes, thanks to which viewers will be transported to the extraordinary world of animals.There, death can come without warning.Even the most powerful and seemingly invincible kings of the savannah do not know when their last day will come.Viewers will also see how changing weather conditions affect the carnivore clans.During the rainy season, young are born, drought means less food and a dramatic struggle for survival.

programme.title: Predator Fails
programme.desc: Lions, panthers and other predators arouse admiration as reliable hunters.However, hunting down prey requires a lot of effort from them.Very often, their search for prey ends in failure, which means hunger.Viewers will see how the most famous hunters in the animal world cope.They will learn how strength, speed, strategy and teamwork make predators successful in chasing, fighting and killing.They will see the difference between ocean hunters and forest hunters and savannah kings.The creators of the series show how poisonous venom, sharp claws and huge mouths are used.They also present survival strategies for potential victims, who often manage to escape the predator.
